highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility and runtime efficiency across rendering, streams, and text shaping.
highlights_body: It updates native packaging for WebGPU and Apple platforms, improves Android rendering synchronization, and reduces allocations in image and HarfBuzzSharp operations.

bullets.detail: Android GL texture rendering now synchronizes with the display refresh cycle for smoother, more predictable presentation.
Fixes front-buffered managed streams retaining data after it is no longer needed, reducing unnecessary managed memory use.
Managed image pixel copy operations perform less work, improving efficiency when applications frequently read or copy pixels.
UTF-32 input buffers are pooled and feature-string formatting avoids native allocation while preserving existing decoding behavior.
The WebGPU implementation is included in libSkiaSharp.a so WebAssembly builds receive the required native support.
Native assets now target updated minimum Apple platform versions for supported iOS, macOS, and tvOS environments.
Linux native builds bind bundled HarfBuzz functions locally, keeping the binding aligned with the library shipped by SkiaSharp.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Localized bundled HarfBuzz function binding on Linux and improved Blazor CPU sample test readiness
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Packaged the WebGPU implementation with the SkiaSharp native library
